arcades.addr: 31 Oakey Drive England, RG40 2DT
arcades.notes: Cabs: Aliens Armageddon; Beat Saber Arcade; Connect 4 Hoops; Down The Clown; Grand Piano Keys; Lane Master; Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; OutRun 2 SP DX; Space Invaders Frenzy; Super Bikes; Time Crisis 4
arcades.info_text: Their games have expanded slightly. Might be worth a go.

arcades.name: Wolverhampton Hollywood Bowl
arcades.addr: Wednesfield Road Bentley Bridge Way Wolverhampton West Midlands, WV11 1BP, Wolverhampton
arcades.notes: Cabs: Animal Kaiser; Dark Escape 4D; Deadstorm Pirates Special Edition; Mario Kart Arcade GP DX
arcades.info_text: One of the only arcades in the West Midlands to include a Dark Escape 4D machine and a Deadstorm Pirates Speical Editon machine! / The arcade used to have DDR Euromix 2 machine; this was eventually taken away because of the state it was in and was replaced with a biking machine. / Bar is on the left upon entering the area. / Arcade machines are straight upon entering the area. / Where the arcade machines are, turning right will lead to the bowling area.

arcades.name: Woodlands family theme park
arcades.addr: A3122 Devon Totnes England, TQ9 7DQ, Totnes
arcades.notes: Cabs: Confidential Mission; Ford Racing: Full Blown (2P); Gunblade: NY; Hopping Road; Scud Race
arcades.info_text: While this is mostly a theme park/falconry, there is an arcade upstairs in the "sea dragon" and other soft indoor play areas.

arcades.name: Worcester Bowl
arcades.addr: Bromyard Road Everoak Industrial Estate Worcester England, WR2 5HP, Worcester
arcades.notes: Cabs: Dead Heat (2P); Super Bikes 2 (2P); Terminator Salvation (Unknown Model)

arcades.name: Worthing Lido
arcades.addr: 1 Marine Parade Worthing West Sussex, BN11 3PX, Worthing
arcades.notes: Cabs: Crazy Taxi (Upright); Sega Rally Championship; The Fast and the Furious; The House of the Dead; Time Crisis II; Virtua Tennis
arcades.info_text: No rhythm games to speak of, but has a nice collection of arcade games, all of which are 50p a play! / All games also specify if they accept the new £1 coin or not.

arcades.name: Ye Olde King & Queen
arcades.addr: 13-17 Marlborough Pl, Brighton and Hove Brighton BN1 1UB, Brighton
arcades.notes: Cabs: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; Street Fighter II: Champion Edition; The House of the Dead; The Simpsons (Data East); iCade 60-in-1
arcades.info_text: Pub with a few games and gamblers scattered around / All the games have readers for contactless card payment, and prices are pretty good with £1 generally giving multiple credits
